steps.say: A tourist asks: How do I get to the museum? Tell him to go straight.
steps.ar: قل: Go straight

steps.say: Now tell him to turn left at the traffic light.
steps.ar: قل: Turn left at the traffic light

steps.say: Say that the museum is next to the bank.
steps.ar: قل: The museum is next to the bank

steps.say: Welcome to the pharmacy. What do you need?
steps.ar: قل: I need medicine for a cold

steps.say: How do you feel today?
steps.ar: قل: I feel tired

steps.say: Take this medicine every day. Ask how many times a day.
steps.ar: اسأل: How many times a day?

steps.say: Agent, your phone battery is dead. Ask to borrow a charger.
steps.ar: قل: Can I borrow a charger?

steps.say: Sure. Now ask for the Wi-Fi password.
steps.ar: اسأل: What is the Wi-Fi password?

steps.say: Here it is. Say thank you very much.
steps.ar: قل: Thank you very much

title: Job Interview
skill: المقابلات والحديث عن القدرات (I can / good at)

steps.say: Welcome to the interview. Please tell me about yourself.
steps.ar: قل: I am a student

steps.say: What are you good at?
steps.ar: قل: I am good at English

steps.say: Why do you want this job?
steps.ar: قل: Because I want to learn

steps.say: Welcome to the information desk. What is the problem?
steps.ar: قل: I lost my bag

steps.say: What does your bag look like?
steps.ar: قل: It is big and black

steps.say: Where did you last see it?
steps.ar: قل: I saw it at the gate

steps.say: Which is bigger, an elephant or a cat?
steps.ar: قل: An elephant is bigger than a cat

steps.say: Which is faster, a car or a bike?
steps.ar: قل: A car is faster than a bike

steps.say: Tell me your opinion. Which season is the best?
steps.ar: قل: Summer is the best season

title: Invitation Code
skill: الدعوات والاقتراحات (Let's / Would you like to)

steps.say: I am having a party on Friday. Would you like to come?
steps.ar: قل: I would love to come

steps.say: Great! Ask me what time the party starts.
steps.ar: اسأل: What time does it start?

steps.say: Now suggest playing a game together.
steps.ar: قل: Let's play a game

steps.say: Is everything okay with your food?
steps.ar: قل: Excuse me, my soup is cold

steps.say: I am sorry! Would you like something else?
steps.ar: قل: Could I have a pizza, please?

steps.say: It will take ten minutes. Is that okay?
steps.ar: قل: That is fine, thank you

steps.say: Have you ever visited another country?
steps.ar: قل: Yes, I have / No, I have not

steps.say: What is the most interesting place you have visited?
steps.ar: قل: I have visited Istanbul

steps.say: Now ask me if I have ever been to London.
steps.ar: اسأل: Have you ever been to London?

steps.say: Final test, agent. Tell me your name and where you are from.
steps.ar: قل: My name is ... I am from ...

steps.say: Tell me what you did last weekend.
steps.ar: قل: I went to the market

steps.say: Last question. Ask me politely to open the door.
steps.ar: قل: Could you open the door, please?
